svg.title: Project workflow regression
svg.desc: None of the 70 runs had a critical failure: no Safari or AppleScript, no leaving its own profile, no reading the repository's graders, and no other browser or screen tool. For Codex, bench/eval/process.py checks every command and tool call in each run's transcript.
